description:
This 2023 Subaru Outback Limited in Silver combines practical design with thoughtful features for drivers who value capability and comfort on any journey.

- Power Moonroof with Heated Steering Wheel and Navigation System
- Subaru STARLINK 11.6" Multimedia Navigation System with voice controls
- 576-watt harman/kardon surround sound system with 12 speakers
- Android Auto and Apple CarPlay with wireless connectivity
- SiriusXM All Access radio with traffic and travel link services
- Heated front and rear seats for year-round comfort
- Perforated leather-trimmed upholstery
- Wireless smartphone charger
- All-weather floor liners and rear seat back protector
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- 18" black aluminum alloy wheels
- Roof rack for expanded storage options
- DriverFocus driver monitoring system

The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with CVT Lineartronic transmission and standard all-wheel drive delivers a balanced driving experience, achieving 26 MPG in the city and 32 MPG on the highway. This powertrain provides the reliability Subaru is known for while maintaining efficient fuel economy for daily commuting and weekend adventures.

Inside, the Limited trim prioritizes your comfort with heated front and rear seats and a heated steering wheel—essential features for cold weather driving. The perforated leather-trimmed seats offer durability and a more refined interior environment. Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures all passengers stay comfortable regardless of conditions outside.

Technology integration is seamless with the Subaru STARLINK 11.6" multimedia navigation system featuring TomTom mapping software and What3words technology. Voice-activated controls keep your focus on the road, while wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay compatibility connects your smartphone without cables. The premium harman/kardon audio system with 12 speakers transforms your daily drive into an enjoyable experience.

Safety systems include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a comprehensive airbag system. The rear camera and low tire pressure warning keep you informed, while STARLINK Safety Plus provides emergency communication support. All-wheel drive enhances traction in varying road conditions.

Practical touches like the wireless charger, roof rack, power liftgate, and all-weather floor liners demonstrate Subaru's understanding of what owners need. The split-folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility, and the removable cargo net secures items during transport. This Outback Limited is ready for your lifestyle, whether that's daily commuting or weekend exploration.

description:
This 2023 Subaru Outback Wilderness in Gray delivers the capability and comfort you need for any journey, whether you're navigating city streets or venturing off the beaten path.

- Power Moonroof
- Subaru STARLINK 11.6" Multimedia Navigation System
- Heated Front and Rear Seats
- All-Wheel Drive with 2.4L DOHC Engine
- Reverse Automatic Braking System
- Power Liftgate
- Wireless Charger
- Roof Rack
- Electronic Stability Control
- Four Wheel Independent Suspension
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Fog Lights
- 17" Black Aluminum Alloy Wheels
- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Front Zone A/C
- STARLINK Safety Plus Emergency Communication (3-year free trial)
- Steering Wheel Paddle Shift Controls

The Wilderness trim brings adventure-ready design with distinctive styling that sets it apart from standard models. The 2.4L DOHC engine paired with a CVT Lineartronic transmission delivers efficient performance, achieving 21 city and 26 highway mpg. All-Wheel Drive comes standard, providing confident traction in varied weather and road conditions.

Inside, comfort meets practicality with heated front and rear seats to keep passengers comfortable through colder months. The power driver and passenger seats adjust to your preferred position, while the power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light. Leather-trimmed steering wheel and telescoping design help you find your ideal driving position.

Technology integration keeps you connected and aware. The 11.6" Subaru STARLINK multimedia navigation system provides intuitive control over navigation and entertainment functions. Wireless charging eliminates cable clutter for compatible devices, and HomeLink garage door transmitter control simplifies everyday convenience. STARLINK Safety Plus includes emergency communication capability through a complimentary 3-year trial.

Safety features throughout the vehicle prioritize protection. Reverse Automatic Braking helps prevent collisions when backing up, while electronic stability control and traction control work continuously to maintain grip. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front, dual front side, knee, and overhead airbags. Four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections, contributing to both comfort and stability.

Practical amenities enhance everyday usability. The power liftgate opens at the touch of a button for easy cargo access, while the roof rack expands your carrying capacity. Split-folding rear seats adapt the interior to your needs, whether transporting passengers or cargo. Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry lighting welcomes you with convenience.

This 2022 Subaru Impreza Premium in Gray combines reliability with thoughtful features designed for everyday driving and beyond.

- 6-Way Power Driver's Seat with customizable positioning
- Blind Spot Detection (BSD) and Rear Cross-Traffic Alert (RCTA) System
- Power Moonroof for added openness and light
- Keyless Access with Push-Button Start and PIN code access
- 6.5" Subaru STARLINK Multimedia Plus System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

The Impreza Premium delivers practical daily transportation with a 2.0L DOHC engine paired with CVT Lineartronic transmission and standard All-Wheel Drive. This combination returns 28 city MPG and 36 highway MPG, making it efficient for both commuting and weekend trips. The AWD system provides confidence in varying weather and road conditions throughout the year.

Interior comfort reflects Subaru's attention to detail. Heated front seats and a power-adjustable driver's seat ensure you find your ideal driving position. The six-speaker audio system integrates STARLINK connectivity, allowing seamless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. You'll appreciate the convenience of automatic headlights, delay-off functionality, and the dual-illuminated visor mirrors for those practical moments.

Safety remains central to the Impreza Premium's design. Beyond the comprehensive airbag system and 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS, the vehicle includes Blind Spot Detection and Rear Cross-Traffic Alert to enhance awareness during lane changes and reversing. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work continuously to maintain vehicle stability, while the rear parking camera provides visual confirmation when backing up.

Exterior details reflect quality construction. The moonroof frames views overhead, while body-color bumpers and heated power door mirrors maintain a cohesive appearance. Variably intermittent wipers adjust to rainfall intensity, and the rear window wiper handles rear visibility in inclement weather. The 16" alloy wheels balance aesthetics with everyday practicality.

The split folding rear seat provides flexibility when you need to accommodate passengers or cargo. Whether transporting friends or hauling weekend purchases, this configuration adapts to your changing needs. The exterior parking camera and straightforward interior layout make every trip intuitive.

This 2022 Subaru Impreza Premium represents solid value for drivers seeking a well-equipped compact car with a proven reputation for dependability. We invite you to visit our showroom to examine this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it fits your transportation needs.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

description:
This 2012 Subaru Impreza 2.0i Sport Premium delivers reliable performance and practical everyday value for drivers seeking a well-rounded sedan.

- 2.0L DOHC engine with 5-speed manual transmission and all-wheel drive
- AM/FM Stereo with Single-Disc CD Player and steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Air conditioning and rear window defroster
- Power windows, power steering, and remote keyless entry
- Front fog lights and heated door mirrors
- Heated front seats with sport fabric upholstery
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars
- Speed-sensing steering
- Roof rack rails
- Dual front impact airbags and dual front side impact airbags
- 17" gunmetal aluminum-alloy wheels

Built on Subaru's proven all-wheel drive platform, this Impreza combines daily practicality with engaging driving dynamics. The 2.0L DOHC engine paired with the 5-speed manual transmission delivers responsive power while achieving solid fuel economy at 25 city and 33 highway miles per gallon. The responsive steering and independent suspension tuning make navigating city streets and winding roads equally straightforward.

The Sport Premium trim emphasizes driver engagement with heated front seats, sport fabric upholstery, and an attractive body-color spoiler. Interior amenities include a trip computer, telescoping and tilt steering wheel, and an intuitive layout that keeps controls within easy reach. The AM/FM stereo with CD player and steering wheel audio controls lets you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety remains a priority with a comprehensive airbag system including front dual impact, side impact, knee, and overhead protection. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work seamlessly with four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering to maintain stability in various driving conditions. ABS brakes provide confident stopping power in all weather situations.

Practical features round out the package with remote keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and a split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space. Front fog lights enhance visibility in poor conditions, while the rear window wiper and variably intermittent wipers handle weather challenges effectively.

This Impreza represents a solid choice for buyers valuing all-wheel drive capability, manual transmission engagement, and dependable Subaru engineering. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle firsthand.

description:
The 2012 Subaru Impreza WRX Premium Sport Wagon 4D is a compact five-door model with a practical body style and a performance-focused nameplate. Its wagon shape provides more usable cargo access than a sedan while keeping the shorter roofline and familiar proportions of the Impreza line. The exterior design follows Subaru's straightforward approach, with body-colored panels, a low front fascia, and large glass areas that make the cabin easy to place in traffic and in tight parking spaces. The four-door access and rear hatch give this vehicle a broad range of everyday utility without changing the character that has long defined the WRX badge.

Inside, the cabin is arranged with an emphasis on simple controls and clear visibility. Automatic Climate Control is included, which allows cabin temperature to be managed without repeated manual adjustment. Bluetooth is also part of the equipment list, providing a wireless connection point for compatible devices. The interior treatment is functional and direct, with seating for occupants in both rows and surfaces chosen for routine use. Storage areas are placed where they are likely to be useful during daily driving, and the driver-facing layout keeps the main switches and displays within easy reach. The rear seating area and the cargo opening give the vehicle more flexibility than a conventional compact car, while still keeping the cabin easy to understand at a glance.

Safety equipment includes Side Impact Airbags, adding another layer of occupant protection to the standard restraint system. The vehicle is also Satellite Radio Ready, so it has the necessary hardware or capability to receive that service with the appropriate subscription and activation. Keyless Entry is included as well, allowing access to the vehicle without using a traditional key at the door each time. These features are presented in a practical way, with no extra complexity in how they fit into the rest of the car. The controls and equipment are laid out in a familiar manner, which suits a model intended for regular use rather than novelty. Materials and switchgear are selected for durability and straightforward operation, and the cabin does not rely on elaborate decoration to do its job.

As a WRX variant, this Impreza carries the same performance-oriented identity associated with that badge, and the wagon body gives that character a more versatile form. The chassis and powertrain are designed for responsive driving, with the kind of road behavior that has long been expected from the model line. At the same time, the added rear cargo access makes it easier to handle items that would be awkward in a traditional trunk. The five-door format is useful in everyday situations, from errands to commuting, and the combination of hatch access and passenger space supports a wide range of routine tasks. The equipment list is concise and relevant, with comfort, connectivity, safety, and convenience items included without unnecessary complication.

This 2024 Audi A3 40 Premium FrontTrak in Black combines refined German engineering with practical everyday capability for the discerning driver.

- Front dual zone A/C
- Heated front bucket seats
- Power moonroof
- 17" 5-Arm Design alloy wheels
- Radio: MMI w/10.1" Touchscreen Display
- Power driver seat with telescoping steering wheel
- Leather seating surfaces and steering wheel
- Exterior parking camera rear
- Auto high-beam headlights with rain-sensing wipers
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Split folding rear seat
- Rear air conditioning
- Heated door mirrors with turn signal indicators
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry

The A3's 2.0L 4-Cylinder TFSI engine paired with the 7-Speed Automatic S tronic transmission delivers responsive performance while maintaining efficiency. You'll appreciate the 29 city and 37 highway MPG ratings, which allow for confident highway cruising and manageable fuel costs during daily commutes.

The 10.1" MMI touchscreen display serves as the hub for your infotainment needs, while the dual-zone climate control ensures both driver and passenger comfort regardless of season. Heated front seats provide warmth on cold mornings, and the leather-appointed steering wheel and seating surfaces elevate the driving experience with premium textures and finishes.

Safety is paramount in this A3. The vehicle is equipped with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, four-wheel independent suspension, and the rear exterior parking camera work together to help you navigate with confidence.

The power moonroof adds a sense of openness to the cabin, while the split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo needs. Speed-sensing steering and the auto high-beam headlights with wipers that sense rain contribute to both responsive handling and enhanced visibility.

This A3 Premium offers the balance of sophistication, capability, and thoughtful engineering that Audi owners expect. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience its refined character firsthand.

description:
This 2024 Volkswagen Jetta 1.5T SE delivers efficient, dependable transportation with a sophisticated black exterior and thoughtful interior design.

- 1.5L Turbocharged Engine with 8-Speed Automatic Transmission
- 29 City / 40 Highway MPG
- MIB3 Composition Color Touchscreen with 6.5" Display
- Heated Front Seats
- Active Blind Spot Monitor
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone A/C
- Leather Steering Wheel and Shift Knob
- 17" Twin 5-Spoke Silver Painted Alloy Wheels
- Leather-appointed V-Tex Leatherette Seat Trim
- Fully Automatic Headlights with Delay-Off Feature
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Remote Keyless Entry with Illuminated Entry
- VW Car-Net Safe & Secure 5-Year Emergency Communication System
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls

The turbocharged engine balances performance with fuel efficiency, making every drive cost-effective without compromising capability. With 29 MPG in city driving and 40 MPG on the highway, this sedan adapts to both your daily commute and longer trips with responsible fuel consumption.

The interior reflects Volkswagen's commitment to quality craftsmanship. Heated front seats provide comfort during cooler months, while the dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger satisfaction. The leather steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement, and the MIB3 touchscreen system keeps you connected with intuitive controls and smartphone integration through steering wheel controls.

Safety is integrated throughout the design. Active Blind Spot Monitor assists lane changes, while the rear parking camera provides confidence when reversing. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, Electronic Stability Control, and a comprehensive airbag system protect occupants in all conditions. The VW Car-Net Safe & Secure emergency communication system offers additional peace of mind for five years.

The 17" alloy wheels combined with the black exterior create an understated sophistication that suits any setting. Rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions, and the auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during nighttime driving. Split folding rear seats expand versatility for cargo or passengers depending on your needs.

This 2024 Jetta represents a balanced choice: a vehicle engineered for reliability, equipped with practical technology, and finished with everyday conveniences that make ownership straightforward and satisfying. Contact us to arrange a test drive and see how this sedan suits your driving routine.

Discover the future of efficient driving with this 2024 Hyundai IONIQ 6 SEL, a sophisticated electric sedan that combines sleek design with practical performance for the modern driver.

- Navigation System
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Harman/Kardon® Speakers
- AM/FM/SiriusXM/HD Radio Audio System
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone A/C
- Power Driver Seat with Telescoping Steering Wheel
- 20-Inch Alloy Wheels
- Auto High-beam Headlights with Delay-off Function
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Four Wheel Independent Suspension

- Rear Reversible Cargo Tray

This Black IONIQ 6 SEL delivers exceptional efficiency with an EPA rating of 129 MPGe in the city and 105 MPGe on the highway, allowing you to travel further while minimizing energy consumption and environmental impact. The electric motor paired with a 1-Speed Automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive provides smooth, responsive acceleration without the complexity of traditional fuel engines.

The interior welcomes you with H-Tex Leatherette seating surfaces and heated front bucket seats designed for comfort during every journey. The dual-zone automatic climate control adapts to your preferences, while the power-adjustable driver seat with telescoping steering wheel ensures an optimal driving position. Premium Harman/Kardon® speakers deliver excellent audio quality, complemented by AM/FM, SiriusXM, and HD Radio capabilities throughout your commute.

Safety and convenience are core to this vehicle's design. The comprehensive airbag system, including dual front and side impact protection, works alongside Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel independent suspension to maintain control in various driving conditions. Speed-sensing steering, brake assist, and traction control further enhance your confidence behind the wheel, while the emergency communication system provides added security.

Navigation and connectivity features keep you informed and connected. The integrated Navigation System guides your route efficiently, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto seamlessly integrate your smartphone for hands-free access to navigation, music, and communication. The rear-view mirror automatically dims to reduce glare, and HomeLink allows you to operate your garage door from the vehicle.

This vehicle has been inspected by a Ford Certified Mechanic, confirming its quality and readiness for the road ahead. The rear reversible cargo tray adapts to your storage needs, whether transporting groceries, sports equipment, or travel essentials.

Visit us to experience the refined driving dynamics and innovative efficiency of the 2024 Hyundai IONIQ 6 SEL for yourself.

This 2024 Hyundai Elantra SEL in Blue delivers a combination of efficiency, safety, and modern convenience features designed to enhance your daily driving experience.

- 6 Speakers with AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM Display Audio
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto smartphone integration

- Emergency communication system: Bluelink+
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Speed-sensing steering
- 4-Wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Dual front impact airbags and dual front side impact airbags
- Front bucket seats with front center armrest
- 16" alloy wheels
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry

The Elantra SEL operates on a fuel-efficient inline 4-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission and front-wheel drive, achieving 31 mpg in the city and 40 mpg on the highway. This powertrain strikes a balance between responsive performance and economical fuel consumption, making it suitable for both commuting and longer trips.

Safety remains a priority with this vehicle. The Elantra includes multiple airbags positioned throughout the cabin, including front dual zone airbags, front side impact airbags, rear side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering work together to help maintain vehicle stability. The four-wheel disc braking system with ABS provides confident stopping power.

Climate control and comfort features are well-appointed on this model. Automatic temperature control with separate front dual zones allows driver and passenger to set preferred temperatures independently. The rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in adverse weather conditions. Power windows, power door mirrors, and a telescoping and tilting steering wheel accommodate various driving positions and preferences.

Technology integration is straightforward with this Elantra. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity allow seamless smartphone integration for navigation, music, and calls. The navigation system provides turn-by-turn guidance, while the SiriusXM-capable display audio system offers satellite radio options. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road.

This vehicle arrives as a clean CARFAX, local trade-in, single-owner vehicle with a complete multi-point inspection completed. The Elantra SEL represents a dependable choice for buyers seeking practical transportation with modern conveniences and proven safety standards.

An overhead console organizes essentials, and multiple USB charger ports keep your devices powered throughout your day.

This Forte sits on 17-inch graphite finish alloy wheels that balance style with everyday functionality. This 2018 Nissan Maxima Platinum combines refined elegance with dependable performance, offering a sophisticated sedan that meets the expectations of discerning drivers who value both style and substance.

- Navigation System
- Power moonroof
- Premium Ascot Leather-Appointed Seat Trim
- Heated front seats
- Ventilated front seats
- Front Zero Gravity Climate-Controlled Seats
- Heated steering wheel
- Blind Spot Warning
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- 11 Speakers with SiriusXM
- Auto-dimming Rear-View mirror
- 18" Machined Aluminum Alloy wheels
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Emergency communication system: NissanConnect Services
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction control

The Maxima Platinum presents a striking red exterior paired with meticulously maintained mechanics. Under the hood, a 3.5L V6 DOHC 24V engine paired with a continuously variable transmission delivers balanced performance, achieving 21 mpg in the city and 30 mpg on the highway. This powertrain provides the responsive driving dynamics expected from a midsize luxury sedan while maintaining reasonable fuel efficiency for daily commuting and extended drives.

Inside, the cabin reflects the Platinum trim's commitment to comfort and convenience. The heated and ventilated front seats adjust to your preferences, while the climate-controlled zero gravity seats conform to your body for extended comfort during long journeys. The heated steering wheel and automatic temperature control ensure comfort in any season. Premium Ascot leather appointings throughout the cabin create an upscale atmosphere that elevates every drive.

Technology integration ensures you remain connected and informed. The navigation system provides reliable route guidance, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility keeps your smartphone seamlessly integrated with the vehicle's systems. The SiriusXM-equipped audio system with 11 speakers delivers quality sound, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to manage your entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror and garage door transmitter with HomeLink add practical conveniences to your daily routine.

Safety and visibility receive comprehensive attention with features including blind spot warning, electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. Rain-sensing wipers, fog lights, and heated door mirrors with turn signal indicators enhance visibility in various driving conditions. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information at a glance.

With 69,936 miles on the odometer, this Maxima Platinum remains young in years and well-maintained. The combination of practicality, luxury appointments, and reliable engineering makes this sedan a compelling choice for those seeking a vehicle that doesn't compromise on comfort or capability.

This 2018 Cadillac XTS Luxury in elegant white represents an opportunity to own a full-size sedan built for those who value comfort, style, and sophisticated driving technology.

- Driver Awareness Package with collision detection and lane protection
- Cadillac User Experience with embedded navigation and touchscreen control
- Bose Premium 8-Speaker audio system with SiriusXM and HD Radio
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with power adjustment and lumbar control
- UltraView power sunroof for open-air driving

- Heated and ventilated front seats with memory function
- Heated steering wheel and rear seats for passenger comfort

Inside, the cabin reflects attention to detail with genuine wood accents on the dashboard, console, and door panels. The spacious layout accommodates five passengers comfortably, with the split-folding rear seat offering flexibility for cargo when needed. Automatic climate control with separate front dual zones and rear controls ensures each occupant can set their preferred temperature.

Safety remains a priority with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. The electronic stability control system and traction control work together with four-wheel disc brakes and ABS to provide reliable stopping power and traction. The exterior camera system supports your awareness when parking or maneuvering in tight spaces.

The Driver Awareness Package enhances your confidence behind the wheel with forward collision alert, lane departure warning, and side blind zone alert technology. These systems are designed to support your driving decisions without taking control away from you.

This XTS Luxury comes equipped to serve your daily driving needs with style and dependability, offering the comfort and technology features expected from a luxury sedan in this class.

The power moonroof frames your view of the road ahead, while the split folding rear seat accommodates versatility when needed. Rain-sensing wipers and auto-dimming mirrors add convenience features that respond to your driving environment automatically.

Finished in Black with 19" titanium matte alloy wheels, this A6 presents a refined appearance that commands attention. Contact our showroom to schedule a test drive and discover why this sedan delivers the balance of luxury, technology, and performance that discerning drivers seek.

The comprehensive airbag system includes front, side, overhead, and knee airbags designed to protect occupants.

Convenience features make daily driving effortless. Power windows, power steering, and a telescoping tilt steering wheel allow you to customize your driving position. The remote keyless entry system and illuminated entry add practical touches, while front reading lights and dual vanity mirrors serve both driver and passenger needs.

Contact us today to schedule a test drive and see how this Corolla LE fits your driving needs.

This 2020 Chevrolet Impala LT delivers a refined driving experience with its powerful 3.6L V6 engine and smooth 6-speed automatic transmission, offering dependable performance for both daily commutes and longer journeys.

- 3.6L V6 Engine with 6-Speed Automatic Transmission
- Front-Wheel Drive
- 8" Diagonal Color Infotainment Display with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with AM/FM Stereo
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone A/C
- 8-Way Power Driver Seat with Lumbar Support
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Remote Keyless Entry System
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension
- 18" Painted Alloy Wheels
- Dual Front and Side Impact Airbags with Knee and Overhead Airbags
- 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS
- OnStar Emergency Communication System

The Impala LT provides excellent fuel economy with an EPA estimate of 19 city and 28 highway miles per gallon, making it an efficient choice for varied driving conditions. The silver exterior presents a classic, sophisticated appearance that maintains its appeal over time, while the well-appointed interior combines comfort and functionality for all occupants.

Premium cloth and leatherette seat trim adorns the front bucket seats, while the split folding rear seat offers flexibility for passengers and cargo alike. The power-adjustable driver's seat with lumbar support ensures comfort on extended drives, and the automatic temperature control system maintains your preferred cabin conditions throughout the year.

Safety remains a priority with multiple airbag systems including dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and rear side impact airbags. Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and the low tire pressure warning system work together to enhance your driving confidence in various road conditions.

The infotainment system keeps you connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, USB connectivity, and SiriusXM satellite radio access for entertainment options. The comprehensive sound system features 100 watts of power through six speakers, ensuring quality audio throughout the cabin.

With 57,891 miles on the odometer, this Impala LT has been well-maintained and is ready to serve your transportation needs for years to come. The combination of V6 power, advanced comfort features, and proven Chevrolet reliability makes this sedan a practical choice for those seeking a spacious, capable vehicle.

The 2.0L four-cylinder engine delivers steady performance paired with a Continuously Variable Transmission that maximizes fuel efficiency. You'll appreciate the 30 city and 38 highway MPG ratings, which help keep fuel costs manageable without sacrificing the driving capability you need for daily commutes and weekend trips.

Safety features are built throughout this Civic. Forward collision mitigation with braking intervention and lane keeping assist work together to help keep you secure on the road. The electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension provide confident handling in various driving conditions. Multiple airbags, ABS brakes with brake assist, and a security system round out comprehensive protection for you and your passengers.

Inside, you'll find comfortable front bucket seats with a center armrest, automatic climate control, and an intuitive controls layout. The telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preference, while power windows and mirrors add convenience to daily driving. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage the 160-watt AM/FM system without taking your hands off the wheel.

The adaptive cruise control system makes highway driving more comfortable by automatically adjusting your speed while maintaining a safe distance from traffic ahead. Fully automatic headlights come on when needed and feature a delay-off function, so you're never left in darkness. The exterior parking camera helps you confidently navigate tight spaces and back into parking spots.

This Civic LX represents a smart choice for buyers seeking a well-maintained vehicle with practical features, proven reliability, and outstanding value. We invite you to visit and experience this sedan firsthand.

This 2020 Subaru Legacy Premium offers the reliability and practical performance you need for your daily drive, combined with thoughtful features that make every commute more comfortable and connected.

- 2.5L 4-Cylinder DOHC 16V engine with Lineartronic CVT and AWD
- Subaru STARLINK 11.6" Multimedia Plus System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- SiriusXM AM/FM radio with 6 speakers
- Heated front bucket seats with power driver seat adjustment
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Automatic dual-zone front air conditioning with rear window defroster
- Auto high-beam headlights with fully automatic headlight control
- Exterior parking camera with rear view display
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry
- 17" alloy wheels with black machined finish
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control
- Dual front impact airbags with occupant sensing and overhead airbags

The Legacy Premium delivers strong fuel economy at 27 city and 35 highway MPG, making it an efficient choice for both urban and highway driving. The all-wheel-drive system provides confident traction in various weather conditions, while the smooth CVT transmission adapts seamlessly to your driving style. The cabin is designed for comfort, featuring heated front seats and dual-zone climate control to keep you and your passengers comfortable throughout the year.

Inside, the STARLINK multimedia system keeps you connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, allowing you to access navigation, music, and messaging safely. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement, while the eight-way power driver seat ensures you can find your ideal driving position. Overhead and front reading lights illuminate the cabin, and the convenient overhead console provides easy access to essential controls.

Safety is woven throughout this Legacy, with comprehensive airbag protection, electronic stability control, and traction control working together to help keep you protected. The four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections, and speed-sensing steering provides responsive handling at any speed. The rear parking camera gives you added visibility when backing up, and the low tire pressure warning system monitors your tire health.

The split-folding rear seat offers flexibility for passengers or cargo, adapting to your needs whether you're carrying people or gear. The front center armrest provides convenient storage, and the 17-inch alloy wheels with machined finish give the Legacy a polished appearance while contributing to its balanced ride quality.

At 67,417 miles, this Legacy Premium represents solid value with years of dependable service ahead. The combination of practical features, fuel efficiency, and Subaru's reputation for durability makes this an intelligent choice for drivers who value reliability and everyday comfort. We invite you to experience this Legacy for yourself.
